[SWS_DM_00947] Occurrence Counter increment strategy ’confirmed- DtcBit’
⌈
If the configuration parameter DiagnosticCommonProps.occurrence-
CounterProcessing is set to confirmedDtcBit and a certain event is already
stored in the event memory and the UDS DTC status bit "kConfirmedDTC" is
equal to ’1’, for each transition of UDS DTC status bit "kTestFailed" from ’0’ to
’1’, the DM module shall trigger the increment of the associated occurrence counter by
one.
⌋
